contestants.motive: Build a dependable voting partnership without making promises she cannot keep.

contestants.name: Taylor Kim
contestants.motive: Prove she can win under pressure and earn safety without surrendering her independence.

contestants.motive: Protect people who treat her honestly while keeping the courage to make her own move.

contestants.name: Casey Wilson
contestants.motive: Keep conversations light, compare what people say, and avoid becoming the obvious target.

contestants.name: Riley Johnson
contestants.motive: Turn careful observation into one reliable partnership and a well-timed competition win.

memories.text: Jamie checked in on me during arrival. I appreciated it.
Maya listened when I talked about the pressure of moving in.
Riley questioned my first plan before hearing me out.
Casey's first plan moved faster than I was comfortable with.
Agreed a safety pact with me, at my price.

Week 1 · Eviction
I'm not going to beg. I've played hard and I've played straight, and I'd like the chance to keep doing both. Don't take the easy vote just because it is easy. Show me you can choose for yourselves.

I've looked after people in this house when it wasn't strategic. I'd like to think that counts for something tonight. Keeping me gives you another option in this game. Think about what helps your next move.
The house votes privately to evict.

houseEvents.title: Goodbye Message

choices.label: Keep it classy
choices.description: Wish a houseguest well, and mean it.

houseEvents.title: In the house
houseEvents.narrative: A strange energy fills the house tonight. Everyone is on edge.

houseEvents.title: The Agenda
houseEvents.narrative: The Head of Household calls you up and asks a lot of questions.

choices.label: Read them
choices.description: Work out what this conversation is really for.
choices.lockReason: Not in your character: Intuitive or Analytical

effects.text: The Head of Household was sizing me up for the block.

choices.label: Talk yourself down
choices.description: Make yourself small: no threat, no plan.

choices.label: Pitch a bigger target
choices.description: Point a houseguest at somebody who is more of a threat than you.

choices.label: Promise your vote
choices.description: Offer a houseguest a safety pact: you keep them safe, a houseguest keeps you safe.

choices.label: Keep it light
choices.description: Answer the questions and give nothing away.

houseEvents.title: The Count
houseEvents.narrative: One undecided vote could decide the week.

choices.label: Make the pitch
choices.description: Name the nominee you want gone and ask a houseguest to vote with you.

choices.label: Ask for their vote
choices.description: You are on the block. Ask a houseguest to keep you.
choices.lockReason: You are not on the block
